description.value: Butterica is a fresh-and-fast Indian grill kitchen whose signature Butterica™ butter chicken sauce is made daily from quality ingredients and locally grown tomatoes, with no processed additives or artificial food colouring. The broad menu runs from samosas, pakoras, and naan through curries, noodles, burgers, and rice bowls, covering both meat and vegetarian diners. Orders can be placed for in-person pickup or via Ubereats delivery.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 35m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 60m; stands (10 spaces) at 63m. Total: 18 spaces.
